title: The reconstruction map is a left inverse of the map given by core and tableau
author: Avichai Marmor
work: Schur-positivity of short chords in matchings
difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the author's labelled lemma at source lines 982-985: for a matching m in M_{N,f} with F(m) = (core(m), T), the reconstruction F-tilde of that pair returns m. The proof (source lines 986-995) does not compare the two matchings directly: it first isolates the unstable part by proving that the restriction of m to the complement of the stable set is the matching reconstructed from the tableau through the permutation p(T), a step that needs the invariance of that complement under m to make the restriction defined, and it then invokes the uniqueness of a matching with prescribed restrictions to a set and its complement. The statement records the identity of the two maps and neither the restriction equation nor the uniqueness step.
